name: Visit Saudi
verdict: Visit Saudi is the flagship destination-marketing platform of the Saudi Tourism Authority, a government body established by royal decree in 2020 and a wholly….
note: Rating note: State body → state tier above none. Could be argued severe on Yemen-war grounds, but the Saudi-led intervention has largely wound down, so serious is used. Cross-source: HRW Saudi Arabia chapter https://hrw.org/world-report/2026/country-chapters/saudi-arabia.

why.text: Visit Saudi is the brand of the Saudi Tourism Authority, a Saudi government tourism body. Human Rights Watch records migrant workers in Saudi Arabia facing widespread wage theft and avoidable deaths at work, and the country carried out a record 345 executions in 2024. A tourism brand in a famous stadium makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
